concerns.text: Plan task T000 ('Create amendment_proposal.md adding a paired t-test analysis... aligns the plan with Constitution Principle VII') has no corresponding task in tasks.md. The revision note only says 'amendment approval gates' were dropped as platform-owned, but the amendment DOCUMENT itself is content work. Without it, the plan's Constitution-VII alignment mechanism is unimplemented even though T007 runs the t-test.

concerns.location: plan.md:Project Structure / Constitution Reproducibility Requirements vs tasks.md
concerns.text: No task creates or pins 'requirements.txt' (plan lists it in the project structure; the constitution requires 'A requirements.txt ... pins every Python dependency' and the Code-Execution Agent builds an isolated venv from it). T001–T013 never mention writing this file, so the reproducibility requirement (Constitution Principle I) has no covering task.

The coverage table's 'Ablation, sensitivity, power check' row cites no FR/SC/plan IDs, and plan task IDs (T015a–d, T020, T025/T025a, T045/T045b, T050, T060) are never cross-referenced from tasks.md, leaving the two disjoint ID spaces unlinked (plan T030 = summarization vs tasks T030 = documentation in the revision note). A short mapping or note that tasks.md supersedes plan IDs would remove the ambiguity.
